why: The candidate is a narrower application of User-Centered Design for Learning, applying familiar, simple, interactive LMS features and usability trade-off analysis to learners' anxiety, self-efficacy, and effective task performance.

rejected.verifier: The claim concerns psychological mediation of LMS ease-of-use perceptions, not the user-centered interface evaluation and revision practice.

why: This is a technology architecture and review framework describing educational uses and risks of large multimodal foundation models, not a general explanatory theory of learning or a distinct adoptable educational product.

The candidate is primarily a multimodal-instruction application in which coordinated text, images, animation, speech, translation, code, and visual representations provide complementary routes into understanding, while its other functions are supporting mechanisms or narrower applications.

The online virtual patients are interactive clinical simulations in which learners work through patient scenarios, so this source belongs on the canonical Simulation page rather than constituting a separate element.
This is a reusable educational dataset of LMS access logs linked to student performance, not an instructional element or implementation.
name: LMS connection-log dataset in which computing devices act as sensors recording device type, operating system and connection habits
product_description: A dataset of timestamped LMS accesses, device and operating-system information, login summaries, and academic performance records from Spanish-school students, produced by Fernández-Soriano Francisco Luis et al. (2019).
